title: Million Minds Tech City Master Plan | Ahmedabad
desc: Understand the published Million Minds Tech City master plan, M One Phase 1, office, residential and mixed-use components, and what remains to verify.
h1: Million Minds Tech City Master Plan and Phases
intro: The published Million Minds Tech City master plan describes an integrated Ahmedabad development rather than a single office tower. This independent guide separates the proposed long-term development mix from M One, the Phase 1 office proposition, and explains which details an occupier should verify in current documents.
facts: M One office tower and its associated infrastructure
sections: What the master-plan numbers mean

The developer's public project page and brochure describe 18+ million sq. ft. of integrated development: a 10+ million sq. ft. tech-park component, a 6+ million sq. ft. residential component and more than 2 million sq. ft. of mixed-use retail, hospitality and related space. These are published planning-scale figures, not a statement that every component has been delivered or is available now.

For a corporate location decision, ask for the current phase plan, approved drawings, construction sequence and handover programme. An attractive eventual ecosystem should not be treated as an operating amenity until its delivery and access are confirmed for the proposed lease term.
M One and Phase 1

M One is the first office-tower proposition highlighted in the brochure. The brochure describes a G+16 configuration with two floors dedicated to amenities, a typical approximately 42,000 sq. ft. carpet floor plate and a 4.2-metre typical floor height. These are brochure-level specifications; a specific unit may have a different area, configuration or handover condition.

The published brochure also includes ground-level arrival and parking plans, a podium plan and office-floor layouts. Use those drawings to prepare questions, then request the latest approved plan and marked-up unit drawing before conducting a test fit or agreeing commercial area.
How the mixed-use components could affect an office occupier

The planned combination of offices, residences, retail and hospitality is intended to support a walk-to-work setting. For an employer, the practical value depends on when each component opens, which amenities employees can access, operating hours, service levels and how pedestrian and vehicle circulation are managed.

Ask specifically about construction-phase interfaces: noise, dust, temporary access, traffic management, emergency routes, contractor separation and employee wayfinding. A phased master plan can be suitable for a business, but delivery dependencies belong in its risk register.
Location and SEZ boundaries

The developer places Million Minds Tech City behind Nirma University, off SG Highway in Ahmedabad. Its materials describe an IT/ITeS SEZ context. Neither the development's proximity to GIFT City nor its broader mixed-use vision makes it part of GIFT City or proves that every building and unit has the same regulatory status.

An occupier should obtain the exact premises address, current SEZ notification or approval documents relevant to the proposed space, and advice from its legal and tax advisers. Compare those documents with the entity's activity and operating model before treating a location label as an incentive entitlement.
Master-plan due-diligence checklist

Request a dated site master plan with plot and tower identifiers; approved and proposed phases; current completion and occupancy evidence; roads, entrances and pedestrian paths; utilities and backup arrangements; parking allocations; amenity delivery dates; and the exact contractual premises description. Keep the version number with the commercial proposal so design changes can be tracked.

A site visit should distinguish what is open today, under fit-out, under construction and only shown as a future concept. Record these categories separately in the board paper and in employee-facing communications. The project office-space and specifications guides cover the unit-level questions in more detail.
faqs: How large is the published Million Minds Tech City master plan?
Developer material describes 65 acres and more than 18 million sq. ft. of planned integrated development. Confirm the current approved scope and phase status.
Is M One the entire project?
No. M One is the highlighted Phase 1 office tower within a wider planned tech-park, residential and mixed-use development.
Are all master-plan amenities open today?
The published vision does not establish current operating status. Request a dated amenity and phase-delivery schedule before relying on any component.
Is Million Minds Tech City inside GIFT City?
No. The developer locates the project off SG Highway in Ahmedabad, behind Nirma University; GIFT City is a separate district.
Which plan should a tenant use for fit-out?
Use the latest approved, unit-specific drawing and technical schedule supplied for the exact proposed premises, not a concept master plan alone.

title: Million Minds Tech City Brochure | Official PDF Guide
desc: Open the official Million Minds Tech City brochure and use this independent guide to its M One plans, specifications, amenities and verification checks.
h1: Million Minds Tech City Brochure and PDF Guide
intro: Looking for the Million Minds Tech City brochure? The direct PDF below is hosted on the project's official domain. This page explains what its published drawings and specifications can answer, what they cannot establish, and which current documents a prospective office occupier should request next.
facts: M One plans, amenities and technical highlights
Confirm revision and unit-specific details before a decision
resourceLink: Open the official project brochure PDF
sections: Where to get the brochure

Use the official project-domain PDF rather than an unverified file shared through a portal or message. The publisher may revise or replace the PDF at the same URL, so save the access date and ask the leasing contact for the current revision when discussing a particular tower, floor or unit.

This independent site does not rehost the developer's brochure or claim ownership of its drawings. The link takes you to the publisher's document; our notes are an interpretation for due diligence, not a substitute for the original material.
What the M One pages show

The brochure describes M One Phase 1 and includes a ground-floor arrival plan, a first-floor podium plan and grouped office-floor layouts. It identifies vehicle and pedestrian entries, visitor areas, lift lobbies, service circulation, amenity areas, restrooms and fire stairs. The office drawings distinguish different floor groups and mark office areas, corridors and refuge spaces.

A headline floor plate is not a unit's contractual area. In the brochure, some illustrated floor-group area labels differ and the notes distinguish gross carpet and refuge components. Ask for a dimensioned, current plan for the exact premises and have an architect test the seating, meeting, support, circulation and compliance programme against it.
Specifications and amenities to check

The brochure refers to a typical approximately 42,000 sq. ft. carpet floor plate, a 4.2-metre typical floor height, power backup, centralised cooling, lifts, building-management systems, EV parking and fire-safety systems. It also illustrates lifestyle, food, childcare and fitness amenities.

Treat each item as a published design or marketing statement until the current delivery stage and exact scope are verified. Request a technical data sheet, utility capacities, equipment schedules, maintenance responsibilities and evidence of any certification relied on by your organisation.
Brochure versus transaction documents

A brochure helps build a shortlist; it is not a live availability register, signed rent quote, approved fit-out plan or proof of occupancy permission. A commercial proposal should state area definitions, premises identity, base rent, maintenance, deposits, escalation, fit-out allowance, handover condition, taxes and key dates in writing.

If SEZ treatment matters to the occupier, request the applicable approvals and professional advice for the particular premises and entity. Do not infer eligibility from a brochure headline alone. The separate SEZ guide sets out the questions to take to legal and tax teams.
A practical document request list

Before a site visit, request the current brochure revision, master plan, exact tower and floor plan, area statement, technical specifications, amenities schedule and status of the spaces being offered. After the visit, ask for the marked-up premises plan, service-level information, fit-out rules and a dated proposal.

Compare every figure across documents. If the brochure, plan and offer letter disagree, ask the owner or authorised leasing representative to reconcile them in writing rather than selecting the most favourable number. Keep the final approved set with the lease record.
faqs: Is there an official Million Minds Tech City brochure PDF?
Yes. The linked PDF is hosted on the project's official domain. Confirm with the publisher that it is the latest revision before relying on it.
Does the brochure show M One floor plans?
Yes. It includes ground-floor, podium and grouped office-floor drawings; request the latest unit-specific drawing for a transaction.
Can I use brochure areas as the final lease area?
No. Confirm the premises-specific measured area and the definition used in the signed commercial documents.
Does the brochure give current rent or vacant units?
It is not a live inventory or binding quote. Obtain a dated written proposal for current availability and all commercial terms.
Is this the official developer website?
No. This is an independent information and leasing-assistance website linking to the official brochure hosted by the project publisher.

title: Million Minds Tech City Rent & Availability Guide
desc: Research Million Minds Tech City office rent and availability without invented rates. Learn what to request in a current M One leasing proposal.
h1: Million Minds Tech City Office Rent and Availability
intro: A search for Million Minds Tech City rent usually needs two answers: which office space is actually available, and what the total occupancy cost will be. Public project material is useful for identifying M One and its broad specifications, but a current unit-by-unit rental quotation is a separate, time-sensitive document.
facts: M One Phase 1 and large office floors
Request a dated written availability statement
Confirm the full cost and area basis in writing
sections: Why a public rent figure can mislead

A single online price can omit floor level, area basis, fit-out condition, lease term, escalation, common-area maintenance, parking and taxes. Public project and brochure material reviewed for this guide describes the development but does not provide a reliable, current quotation for a specific vacant unit. We therefore do not publish an unsupported rate or promise that a particular floor is free.

A useful enquiry states the required carpet area, team size, target move date, preferred fit-out condition, operating hours, power and cooling needs, parking requirement and lease term. These inputs help a leasing team return a comparable written option rather than an attractive but incomplete headline number.
Ask for availability at the exact premises

Request a dated schedule showing tower, floor, unit identifier, measured carpet and chargeable area, combination options, permitted use, SEZ status where relevant, handover state and expected possession date. If the requirement spans several floors, ask whether they are contiguous and whether expansion or phased delivery is possible.

The brochure's approximately 42,000 sq. ft. typical floor plate is a planning reference, not a guarantee of free whole-floor inventory or the net area that will appear in a lease. Review the exact plan and area certificate for every option offered.
Compare a complete office-rent proposal

A written quote should identify base rent and charging unit; common-area maintenance; deposit and advance rent; parking charges; fit-out or rent-free period; escalation; lock-in and exit; utilities; backup power; HVAC operating charges; statutory taxes; and any brokerage or other one-time fees. Obtain the invoice and tax basis before comparing options.

Normalise all proposals to the same area definition and term. A lower rupee-per-square-foot number can cost more overall when the chargeable-area ratio, maintenance, power or fit-out responsibility differs. Finance teams should model cash flow, not just first-year rent.
Technical costs specific to a large workplace

For GCC, IT/ITeS and enterprise teams, check electrical load, UPS and generator interfaces, cooling hours and redundancy, telecom routes, server-room provisions, security zoning, fire and life-safety approvals and any after-hours charges. These can change both the fit-out budget and the operating cost.

If the proposed area is delivered in shell condition, ask who provides raised flooring, ceiling, lighting, partitions, data cabling, pantry infrastructure and access control. Align the fit-out programme with the contractual commencement date and delay protections.
How to move from research to a decision

Use the project brochure and master-plan guides to frame a shortlist, then arrange a site visit for the exact offered floor. Bring real-estate, workplace, IT, security and facilities stakeholders. Photograph and record only with site permission, and reconcile observations with the approved plan and technical schedule.

Before signing, have legal and technical advisers review title and authority, permitted use, approvals, area definitions, handover obligations, service levels and exit rights. This website provides independent research and enquiry assistance, not a binding developer offer or financial advice.
faqs: What is the current rent at Million Minds Tech City?
A reliable figure requires a dated written quote for the exact tower, floor, area, condition and lease term. This page does not invent a current rate.
Is M One office space available now?
Availability changes. Request a current unit and floor schedule from an authorised leasing representative before planning a move.
Does the 42,000 sq. ft. figure mean a vacant full floor?
No. It is a published typical floor-plate reference, not a live vacancy statement or the contractual area of a particular unit.
Which extra costs should I compare?
Compare maintenance, parking, utilities, taxes, deposits, escalation and fit-out responsibilities alongside base rent.
Can an SEZ label determine the rent or tax treatment?
No. Obtain premises-specific documents and legal or tax advice for the occupying entity; a general project description is not enough.
